text: Hello! I recently downloaded this app to try it since I also have the other two apps in the Meow Family. So far, the functions are good. However, I would like to recommend having a daily maximum of 0 (zero) as well, to really monitor the breaking of bad habits, considering I want to break a bad habit by not doing that bad habit at all. Please also put daily maximum to the building habits since I want to build a habit that requires limitation, such as calorie deficit.
